resolved.measurement_boundary: Serial offscreen frames after 30 warmup; frame.cpu ends after submit, excluding GPU wait; frame.wall includes GPU completion but excludes timestamp map/readback and capture writing. GPU command intervals include barriers/scheduling: surface_and_shadows (persistent topology classification/transactions/emission/deformation when selected, then shadow depth); rt_as_build; scene_classify_and_raster (opaque geometry and clear background); motion_vectors (opaque-depth diagnostics, empty when disabled); temporal_resolve (history compute, color copy-back and depth snapshot, empty when disabled); scene_overlays (plume, stars, cloud/aurora); display_transform (pre-exposed HDR to SDR, empty when HDR off); ui (after display). Layout v8 separates resolve from overlays; compare scope names and settings, not just totals, with older captures. Scene raster uses RGBA16Float when native_hdr=true. UI extra egui command buffers and queue-write uploads before the first mark are outside GPU intervals. Auto exposure and bloom remain unapplied in this manual HDR slice even when shared settings request them. Unknown world/sim counters retain defaults; no per-frame geometry readback. Up to 1800 measured frames retained
resolved.native_docking_clock: isolated fixed 120 Hz replay; not flight authority or an ephemeris trajectory
resolved.native_jitter_scope: Halton primary terrain/meshes only; motion excludes sampling jitter; resolved only when native_taa=true; secondary view unchanged
resolved.native_material_reference_height_source: detail enabled: canonical field at eye direction / fixed 32 m wavelength, cached per selection epoch; disabled: legacy datum; not exact per-tile or collision height
resolved.native_motion_scope: render.motion_vectors; stored opaque depth + alpha mask, before temporal resolve and translucent overlays
resolved.native_night_lights_source: static inhabited-land R8 optical proxy; primary terrain only, not activity/electric power or secondary-ray emission
resolved.native_plume_scope: render.scene_overlays (includes depth-clipped plume color-load pass when active)
resolved.native_surface_plants_contract: WORLD11 <=9 same-face L14 large-plant windows plus <=49 same-face L18 near-eye windows; scale-aware full/reduced leaf geometry / disjoint L24 ground-clump IDs with world-addressed 8 m colony occupancy; canonical 32 m descriptors / optional shared optical soil pose; no collision; shared opaque/shadow/environment path
resolved.native_survey_ground_source: canonical PlanetField::height_m(actual eye direction), max(height, sea datum 0); radial AGL, not waves/canopy or resident-mesh clearance
resolved.native_taa_scope: render.temporal_resolve; opaque history and depth snapshot before overlays, including copy-back; no upscaling or generated frames
resolved.native_terrain_environment_scope: render.scene_classify_and_raster; shared sky GGX visible-normal quadrature, including reflected cloud transport; no scene-object terrain reflections
